A '''hyperstream''', also called a '''slipstream''', was a natural phenomenon created by certain trans-dimensional moving objects. Such an object could move in and out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> at speeds faster than those attainable by any [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="Iceworld" /> In its wake, it pulled along vapor and other matter behind it, creating a hyperstream. The hyperstream gave the object the appearance of a comet with a tail.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3" /> A starship could take advantage of this phenomenon, but such travel was unreliable: there was no way to tell where the cometary body was moving. It also carried risks. Passing by a heavy mass, like a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] or [[Star/Legends|sun]], could not only divert the comet's path, but also rip it apart along with the ship it was towing along.<ref name="Iceworld" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] were flying a [[Rebel smuggling ship|smuggling ship]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] through an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]]. Imperial pilots spotted them, and their ship was damaged and outnumbered. There was a trans-dimensional comet in the vicinity, and Skywalker saw it as their only means of escape. Over Threepio's objections, he maneuvered close to the object until their ship became caught in its wake and whisked away. As the cometary body approached the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], the planet's gravity began to break it apart. Skywalker had to skillfully fly the ship out of the slipstream before it was destroyed, then maneuver around the fragments of what had become a meteor shower. The starship crashed on the surface, but both occupants survived. Skywalker later was able to recommend Hoth as a location for the Alliance's [[Echo Base/Legends|new base]].<ref name="Iceworld" />
